about.label: Our App
about.subtitle: Tired of dead WhatsApp groups, no-shows and impossible bookings? PachangApp centralizes everything so you just have to worry about hitting the pitch and playing.
about.origin_title: From a Class Project to the Real Pitch.
about.p1: It all started as a Web Application Development (DAW) Higher Degree Project.
about.p1_end: saw very clearly that the way pickup games were organized in our city was obsolete: the friction of getting exactly 10 players breaks the magic of amateur sports.
about.p2_end: didn't hesitate to join the boat. We both saw the huge potential of automating bookings, connecting unknown players and gamifying the experience of the classic 'Paco, are you coming today?'.
about.p3: Thus PachangApp was born: by and for football fans tired of the bureaucracy of chat groups.
about.mission_title: We Play on the Same Team
about.mission_sub: We believe sport is the original social network. Our mission is to break down logistical barriers so anyone, anytime, can play a quality match.
about.offer_sub: Features designed specifically for the amateur football ecosystem.
about.final_sub: Don't wait any longer. Join, choose your position, check stats and show who rules the pitch.
about.footer: Made with passion by Ibrahim and Pablo · © 2026 PachangApp
about.ibrahim_desc: The brain behind the initial idea. Fan of clean code and one-touch play.
about.pablo_desc: Tech-savvy obsessed with scalability and the ball always hitting the top corner.

features.f1_desc: Fuentenueva or Cartuja? Search availability and book without a single call.
features.f2_desc: Find pickup games near you, see who plays and apply for open spots.
features.f3_desc: Organize your own. Define level, spots, price and we take care of filling it.
features.f4_desc: Raise your group's level by creating automatic private leagues with standings.
features.f5_desc: Your played matches, goals, karma. Everything centralized in your public profile.

roadmap.phase1_desc: Launch in our hometown. Exclusive closures with key sports centers and creation of the first large community.
roadmap.phase2_desc: Bring the solution to the rest of Andalusia, scaling the Backend infrastructure and optimizing for mobile.
roadmap.phase3_desc: Padel, Basketball, Tennis... If it requires equipment and a court, PachangApp will structure it nationwide.

testimonials.t1_text: "I came to study in Granada and didn't know anyone. Thanks to this crew I already have a regular team for Thursdays at Fuentenueva. Just what was needed!"
testimonials.t2_text: "I'm the typical loser who has to find a field and coordinate schedules every week. This saves my life entirely. Super intuitive too."
